input: Sign up for a beginner's yoga class

gold.taskTitle: Sign Up for a Beginner Yoga Class
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and register for a beginner-level yoga class.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person classes or online ones?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants a physical studio experience or a virtual/streaming class format.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the class be in?
questions.description: Identify the geographic location to narrow down relevant studios or gyms.

questions.title: Do you have a target start date in mind?
questions.description: Determine when the user wants to begin so the search can be filtered by upcoming availability.

questions.title: Which days of the week work best for you?
questions.description: Identify scheduling preferences to match classes that fit the user's weekly routine.

questions.title: What is your budget per class or per month?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints to filter out studios or memberships that are out of range.

questions.title: Is there a specific yoga style you are curious about?
questions.description: Find out if the user has any interest in a particular beginner-friendly style such as Hatha, Vinyasa, or Yin.

questions.title: Do you have any physical limitations the class should accommodate?
questions.description: Identify any injuries, mobility restrictions, or health conditions that should influence the class choice.
